gloss: to shake; to rock; to sway

definitions.explanation: To move something back and forth or side to side repeatedly.
To disturb someone's emotions or convictions, to make them waver.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{揺|ゆ}さぶって{起|お}こした。
その{映画|えいが}は{観客|かんきゃく}の{心|こころ}を{揺|ゆ}さぶった。
examples.english: That movie shook the audience emotionally.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{木|き}の{枝|えだ}を{激|はげ}しく{揺|ゆ}さぶった。
examples.english: The wind violently shook the tree branches.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pair: {揺|ゆ}らぐ (intransitive - to sway, waver)
Pattern: Xを{揺|ゆ}さぶる

ASPECT (ている):
{揺|ゆ}さぶっている - is shaking (action in progress)

NUANCE:
Stronger and more forceful than {揺|ゆ}らす. Implies vigorous or repeated shaking.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{肩|かた}を{揺|ゆ}さぶる - to shake someone by the shoulders
・{心|こころ}を{揺|ゆ}さぶる - to move emotionally
・{信念|しんねん}を{揺|ゆ}さぶる - to shake one's convictions

WARNING:
{揺|ゆ}さぶられっ{子|こ}{症候群|しょうこうぐん} (shaken baby syndrome) - violent shaking of infants is dangerous.
